(1) the interpolation of task distributions in self-paced RL is not well-defined for general task distributions, (2) introducing optimal transport concepts allows for a stable interpolation of task distributions, and (3) this results in an efficient and robust curriculum RL algorithm that is not limited to Gaussian task distributions.
the interpolation of task distributions in self-paced reinforcement learning can be degenerate, and that the introduction of a metric structure into the task space can solve this problem.
